scope: public synthetic binary/Koblitz Frobenius maps, no relation search or logarithm extraction
mechanism: Precompute the exact GF(2)-linear Frobenius map as byte lookup tables; use the same uint32 XOR mapping on portable C++ CPU, Metal, CUDA and OpenCL adapters. Preserve a Sage fallback. Separate packed-buffer throughput from complete Sage-point API cost.
invariants: identical field modulus and polynomial-basis encoding
exact point outputs in input order
unsupported devices must fail explicitly or use the declared CPU fallback
counter_changes: repeated field squarings replaced by precomputed linear-map lookups; table construction is charged
measurement: 12 balanced alternating rounds; exact output verification charged in primary full-API wall time. Record plan/table/backend construction separately and cold setup plus first call. Packed-buffer comparison includes dispatch and host/device copies. Kernel-only time is diagnostic. Fresh worker for each cell; preserve every result and failure.
criteria_version: binary-hardware-v1: operation-level adaptation of the repository measurement discipline, not a GNFS gate
criteria: No automatic GPU promotion in this first step. Report per-cell gains only if median speedup exceeds 1.02 and paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound exceeds 1; report regressions and cold break-even. An aggregate or cross-device claim requires successful full-API confirmation on the named devices. No universal speedup claim from portable source or a microkernel.
supersedes: run-002 is complete prototype evidence and preserved
change: Same source kernels and criteria; measure Meson-installed native library and codec with normal package imports and fresh seeds. Installed import failure corrected with codec fast_getattr=False; arithmetic and cases unchanged. intent-v3 never reached timing.
